Few college football rivalries come with as much history and bad blood as Missouri and Kansas. The Tigers and Jayhawks will renew their heated rivalry Friday, Sept. 11, at David Booth Kansas Memorial Stadium in Lawrence, Kansas. Kickoff is set for 5 p.m. PT, airing live nationally on Fox, with several streaming platforms carrying the channel for those who don’t have cable.

Known as the Border War, the rivalry dates back to 1891 and has produced 121 games between Missouri and Kansas. The Missouri Tigers currently hold a narrow edge in the all-time series at 57-55-9, and the teams played against each other nearly every year before Missouri left the Big 12 Conference for the SEC in 2012. With the rivalry revived last season, this highly anticipated matchup is the perfect excuse to throw a watch party.

At a Glance: How to Watch Missouri vs. Kansas College Football Game Free Online

- Date & time: Friday, Sept. 11, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. PT

- TV channel: Fox

- Stream: Get access to Fox on Fubo , DirecTV , Hulu + Live TV and Sling

Missouri enters the game ranked No. 23 and opened the season with a 54-14 win against Arkansas-Pine Bluff, while Kansas cruised past Long Island 51-6. The Missouri Tigers are favored by 5.5 points with an over/under of 50.5, according to updated FanDuel odds. The Tigers also won the last four games, including a 42-31 victory in 2025.
